By creating an account or using MUHETO, you agree to these terms of use.

1. Published content
You remain the owner of your videos and posts. By publishing them, you grant us a license to host and distribute them within the app. You agree not to publish any illegal, hateful, or violent content.

2. User account
You are responsible for keeping your password confidential. You can delete your account at any time from Settings.

3. MUHETO Gold
Billing and cancellation terms for the Gold subscription will be specified before the official payment launch.

4. Moderation
MUHETO reserves the right to remove any content or suspend any account that does not comply with these terms.

5. Contact
For any questions: contact@muheto.app
